About Our Brand and Products

Qessence is a premium grooming and personal care brand built around modern refinement. We create high-quality products for both men and women, formulated with intention and crafted to deliver real results. From hair and body care to everyday essentials, Qessence is designed for those who value quality, confidence, and self-care.

What Makes Us Different

• Premium formulations designed for performance
• Products made for both men and women
• Clean, modern branding that converts
• Purpose-driven product development—not trends
• Strong customer loyalty and repeat-purchase potential

Qessence is more than personal care—it’s a lifestyle of refinement.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn commission on every qualifying sale made through their unique referral link. There’s no cap on earnings, and commissions are paid on completed orders. The more value you bring, the more you earn.

How to Promote Us

You can promote Qessence through:
• Social media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.)
• Product reviews, routines, and tutorials
• Lifestyle, beauty, grooming, and wellness content
• Blogs, websites, and direct link sharing

Authentic content performs best—show real use, real results, and real lifestyle integration.

Other Information

• No misleading or exaggerated claims
• No paid ads using our brand name without approval
• Content must align with a premium, professional brand image
• Affiliates receive access to brand assets and updates

If you’re passionate about premium self-care and quality products, Qessence is the perfect brand to partner with.
payout_period: We payout on the 15th of every month
